description: This line plot illustrates how the Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage varies with different values of N, ranging from 0 to 20 on the linear x-axis labeled “N”. The y-axis, labeled “AUC (%)”, is also linear and spans from 75 to 100 percent. Five distinct lines represent different methods or configurations, each marked with a unique symbol and color: a blue line with circle markers, an orange line with diamond markers, a green line with star markers, a red line with square markers, and a purple line with triangle markers. The blue line starts at approximately 94% when N=0, rises to a plateau near 99.5% from N=5 to N=10, and then gradually declines to about 94.5% at N=20. The orange line begins at approximately 84% at N=0, increases steadily to around 95.5% at N=10, and then slightly decreases to about 94.5% at N=20. The green line starts at approximately 86% at N=0, rises to about 92% at N=5, and then continues to increase to around 93.5% at N=10 before leveling off near 93% at N=20. The red line begins at approximately 87% at N=0, rises to a peak of 99.5% at N=10, and then declines to about 91% at N=20. The purple line starts at 80% at N=0, remains flat until N=5, then sharply increases to 96% at N=10, and subsequently declines to approximately 82% at N=20.
